title: Clean up as part of finishing work: worktrees, builds and temporary files go when they've served, as a standing rule
outcome: Remove a worktree when the item it served closes, as a standing rule in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
acceptance: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md stay byte-identical and, beside the .logs/.evidence rule, say: "Finishing work includes cleaning up after it, without waiting for a disk to fill. When a worktree, build output or temporary file has served its purpose, its owner removes it, after the path check below, and records it; the Merger does so for a landed candidate. To keep one longer, record on an open item the concrete need and when it ends, then remove it then. A periodic sweep doesn't replace this."
The change is a .md-only landing: link check and identity check through the focused launcher, a clean review pair, landed under the standing approval, granting no new authority
The Merger's landing steps and the coders' closing step use the rule from then on, shown once on the next landing

completion.summary: Completed cleanup follow-through and recorded its independent 3/3 acceptance pass.
